Sub UpdateGeorgiaTax()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim fVal As Variant

    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "E").End(xlUp).Row

    For i = 1 To lastRow

            If IsNumeric(fVal) And Not IsEmpty(fVal) Then

                    ' Whole number - no pennies
                    ws.Cells(i, "E").Value = "Georgia WH Tax"
                Else
                    ' Has pennies
                    ws.Cells(i, "E").Value = "Georgia Sales Tax"
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i

Sub UpdateGeorgiaTax()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long, i As Long
    Dim cellE As Range, cellF As Range

    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "E").End(xlUp).Row

    For i = 1 To lastRow
        Set cellE = ws.Cells(i, "E")
        Set cellF = ws.Cells(i, "F")

        If InStr(1, cellE.Value, "Georgia Its Tax", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
            If IsNumeric(cellF.Value) And cellF.Value <> "" Then
                If cellF.Value = Int(cellF.Value) Then
                    ' Whole number - no pennies
                    cellE.Value = "Georgia WH Tax"
                Else
                    ' Includes pennies
                    cellE.Value = "Georgia Sales Tax"
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Sub UpdateGeorgiaTaxLabels()

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim r As Long
    Dim taxValue As Variant

    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "E").End(xlUp).Row

    For r = 1 To lastRow
        If ws.Cells(r, "E").Value = "Georgia Its Tax" Then
            taxValue = ws.Cells(r, "F").Value

            If IsNumeric(taxValue) Then
                If taxValue = Int(taxValue) Then
                    ws.Cells(r, "E").Value = "Georgia WH Tax"
                Else
                    ws.Cells(r, "E").Value = "Georgia Sales Tax"
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next r

End Sub
